metadata.description: Boost your AI agents with powerful tools. Skills, agents, and workflows for supercharging AI-assisted development.

plugins.name: obsidian-knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Turn Obsidian into an AI-managed knowledge graph. Captures architecture decisions, bug investigations, and codebase patterns as persistent memory across coding sessions.

plugins.name: ship-agent-context
plugins.description: In-repo memory for AI agents. Captures plans, decisions, in-flight status, standing user instructions, open questions, and incident scars in docs/agent/ so the next agent (or human) walks into context, not a blank slate.

plugins.name: ship-better-plans
plugins.description: Produce bulletproof, fully-specified, audited implementation plans. Structured intake, automatic docs/agent + codebase discovery, scored tradeoffs, numbered specs with edge cases, a parallelizable task DAG with subagent delegation, and a multi-persona Workflow audit (adversarial/pragmatist/production) before the plan is written to docs/agent/plans/.
